fields.v: Yes (1): 31 instruction-category combinations and two models evaluated under the same prompts, harness and settings (alternatives under the same conditions); no no-agent-file baseline
fields.quote: Although we used the same prompts and experimental settings for both the Gemma4 and GPT5.4 models, LLMs are inherently nondeterministic and may produce different outputs across multiple executions.
fields.why: Q7 asks for a baseline or an alternative under the same conditions; the 31 combinations and two models are alternatives run under the same conditions, so the missing no-agent-file baseline may not justify Partly.
fields.doubt: A Q7 aceita 'baseline ou alternativa nas mesmas condições'. Aqui há 31 combinações e 2 modelos com os mesmos prompts e harness, só falta um baseline sem AGENTS.md. Decide se isso basta para Sim (1) ou se mantens Parcial (0,5) por coerência com outros estudos.

fields.v: Inconsistencies: filter text requires <= 35 LoF or max CC <= 10, but Table II LoF values are 1,156-26,395 (only CC filter holds); RQ2a answer says Testing had the highest compilation rate, but in Table V GPT-5.4 ties at 98.75% for four categories (Testing highest only for Gemma, 88.75%); Table V has "86,25". RQ1b answer says the two lowest-token combinations both included Function Description and Implementation Detail, but in Table IV the second lowest (Gemma 4) is ImpDetl alone (69,344, areyoustillthere), after FuncDec-ImpDetl (68,070); the third, FuncDec-ImpDetl-ReConStp (70,283), fits the claim. Conclusion (p. 10) says Testing was most frequent for File Count, while the results (p. 7) and the abstract say Testing and Reconstruction Steps tied (11 of 16). Text (p. 7) says Gemma 4 FC differed by at most 8.7% for the libraries other than areyoustillthere, but Table VII gives -29.50% for compactor (Gemma 4, FC). Overall GPT-5.4 rates 12.99% passed and 51.32% partial are not whole counts out of 155 variants (extractor's check: 20/155 = 12.90%); denominator not stated. Tables III, IV, VII flattened by pdftotext; Table VI values read by column order. Replication package: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23359831 (agent files, metrics, scripts). Pre-registration: not claimed. Language: Python
fields.quote: Gemma 4 achieved exact FC matches for multiple areyoustillthere library variants, while the remaining library datasets differed by at most 8.7%.
fields.where: §III.B.c Function Count, p. 7; Table VII, p. 8
fields.why: One more reporting inconsistency is missing: the FC text says at most 8.7% for Gemma 4, but Table VII lists -29.50% for compactor.
fields.doubt: O texto da pág. 7 diz que, no Gemma 4, o FC difere no máximo 8,7%, mas a Tabela VII (pág. 8) dá -29,50% para o compactor. Confirma na tabela (o pdftotext pode ter baralhado a ordem) e acrescenta a inconsistência às Notes.
